They are not practical footwear for everyday use, nor are they generally considered stylish or fashionable. There is no indication that the wearing of SCP-8582 would improve your life in any tangible way. There is every indication that the wearing of SCP-8582 would cause inconvenience for yourself and those around you.

It is decorated with paper stickers mimicking the appearance and style of an older model slot machine. A small lever, which is slightly damaged due to wear and tear, is mounted on the right-hand side of SCP-8583.

While its activities are consistent with traditional organized crime, members uniformly wear clown attire and makeup. Documented activities include racketeering, extortion, contract enforcement, and targeted violence. SCP-8669 manifests as a partially translucent, humanoid figure resembling a 9 year old boy. Facial profiling and linguistic analysis of its conversations with D-Class personnel suggest Irish and European descent. The figure wears a slightly tattered wool jacket with a torn sleeve and several patches. Its lower half is clad in what appear to be blue jeans with scorch marks, revealing bare feet covered in soot. Furthermore, SCP-8670 cannot be removed from a subject's long-term memory through any means, including Foundation amnestics. SCP-8672 is an artificially created instance of a common western dragon (Draconis ignis) exhibiting a large number of genetic and cybernetic physical augmentations. Sequencing of its genetic material indicates that its genome has been altered to include spliced DNA belonging to the common wyvern (Draconis ferox).

The anomaly will periodically generate items within itself, regardless of whether or not the space is already occupied. Items recovered from SCP-8673 most often include common office supplies and stationery. SCP-8674 is a graffiti sign that resembles the letter 'S'; it is commonly known as the "Cool S" or "Super S", among other names. SCP-8674 is popular among children and young adults in multiple countries.

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-8675 đề cập đến một đàn gồm 6,500 con chim giấy. Mỗi cá thể riêng lẻ có ngoại hình khác nhau, nhưng toàn bộ có vẻ được tạo ra với chủ đích. Các dị thể có thể được làm từ nhiều loại giấy khác nhau với rất nhiều thiết kế, màu sắc, và chữ viết trên chúng, cũng như nhiều phong cách gấp và vẽ khác nhau. Khi bị đặt trong không gian mở hoặc trong tầm hiện diện của các cá thể SCP-8675 khác, các thực thể có hành vi tương đồng với các cá thể chim hoang dã. Điều này bao gồm các hành vi di cư và tụ tập
SCP-8677 is a black television remote of unknown model. It randomly replaces other non-anomalous remote control devices within Site-01.

SCP-8678 is currently believed to be an entity or number of entities that reside along the northern coast of Alaska and Canada. These entities differ slightly in general appearance, though common characteristics include pale-green skin; a flat face with reduced or no visible nostrils; long black hair and fingernails; and prominent aquatic features, such as fins or webbed fingers/toes. SCP-8678 may be nude, but some instances have been observed wearing a furred amautik,1 and/or carrying a large b

SCP-8679 is the nomenclature assigned to a thaumaturgical molecule whose properties are not currently identified. Given the conditions of the discovery of the compound and the state of degradation due to exposure to high temperatures, it is impossible to replicate or understand its structure in its entirety.
Furthermore, although it is possible to recognize metabolites that could suggest that SCP-8679 was originally an anomalous enzyme, the very presence of residual traces of thaumaturgical acti

SCP-8680 is a device developed by Dr. Claire Somme known as a 'Somme Dimensional Anchor' (or SDA). SCP-8680 functions through the emission of pre-selected anomalous radiation, specifically chosen to be harmless. This emission, over time, overpowers and replaces the much more dangerous dimensional radiation naturally present.
Update: As of the dimensional collapse of SBS-44, the chosen emission source has been replaced with non-anomalous uranium. Dr. Somme is not to be informed of this change.

SCP-8681 is the portfolio of all financial and political capital invested in PHLOX Inc. (See Section 2 for more details.) Being the preeminent Foundation investment of the decade, SCP-8681's success is of critical importance to the Foundation's image and finances. Additionally, control of SCP-8681 enables the Foundation to monitor the use of the PHLOX highway. This access is critical to tracking the movement of Groups of Interest, Persons of Interest, and Socially Transmissible anomalies.

SCP-8682 resembles a headless, 11 week old human fetus. SCP-8682 is calcified and exhibits complete cephalothoracic fusion. SCP-8682 is 4.5 cm in length, has a craniocaudal length of 8 cm, and a weight of 20g. SCP-8682 is stored in a 15x15cm archival plastic container. The container is stained with green bile and red with blood, fluids discharged from the liver of SCP-8682 immediately before its death. Also contained within this discharge were significant amounts of cerebrospinal fluid and eleva

SCP-8683 is the intelligence responsible for adaptive immunity in vertebrate organisms. During immune responses, it restructures the DNA of B-cells within Germinal Centres1 to produce antibodies specific to encountered pathogens and toxins.

SCP-8684 is an unidentified human female who is capable of involuntary reflexive movement of dismembered body parts. This ability has been observed to happen spontaneously even in the absence of any nervous or muscular tissue in the body part in question. Likewise, SCP-8684’s dismembered body parts have been observed to be resistant (but not immune) to chemical changes, up to and including decay and digestion. Aside from these properties, SCP-8684 is not anomalous in any way, and is not understo

SCP-8685 is an organization of anomalous humans capable of medically removing and restoring wasted organs for recycled usage in humans. SCP-8685 instances do not originate from our timeline nor dimension, but do not physically differ from baseline humans. The exact methodology in which they are able to refurbish organs is unknown.
SCP-8685's mission statement is to provide preserve and save lives of individuals from their dimension.

data.descriptionExcerpt:
SCP-8686 là một trải nghiệm sân khấu dị thường mang tên "Những Tháng Ngày Tươi Đẹp Nhất Đời Ta". SCP-8686 được nghi là thuộc quyền sở hữu của "Pseudogenesis Production", hay còn được gọi là TLĐLT-478. Trang đầu tiên của dị thể chứa thông tin về những cá nhân liên quan tới quá trình sản xuất SCP-8686.2 Các phiên bản SCP-8686 xuất hiện trên các trang web đấu giá bao gồm eBay, Etsy, và Craigslist với giá bán dao động từ năm tới mười đô la.

SCP-8687 refers to the phenomena related to the town of Winding Falls2, West Virginia. The majority of individuals present in the town have been exposed to major health hazards, including lead poisoning, drug use, carbon monoxide poisoning, major surgical malpractice and anomalous bodily alterations involving various pieces of technology. Despite this, the town's inhabitants have been found to be able to survive for much longer than would be expected, while still suffering extensive health probl

AO-8688 is a set of anomalous objects consisting of a desktop computer, monitor, peripherals and assorted unknown components. AO-8688 has undetermined anomalous properties - the Foundation is, however, positive that containment should be continued. I'm sure it's important, I'll get to it once I can get Eileen off my ass.

SCP-8689 is a plastic toy snake, constructed by Shenzhen Weizonglianheng Technology Co., Ltd, a Chinese toy manufacturer. The object displays no differences in internal structure when compared to a baseline toy of the same model, except that flipping the switch to 'on', which would normally activate a light and movement function, instead provokes no discernable reaction. Charging, replacement, and removal of the item's internal battery do not alter its properties.

Society at large is not affected, and the anomaly almost exclusively manifests itself - extremely rarely - in SCP agents that have work history with anti-memes and those they have contact with. 8694-instances appear to suffer from a kind of psychosis with the following findings:

Strange speech patterns
Paranoia
Obsessive thought patterns
Inflexible false beliefs
Social contagion

SCP-8696 is a large living mass covered entirely with human limbs. Due to its concealed nature, SCP-8696's size is difficult to estimate, but it is large enough to envelop a human being inside of itself with little to no strain. Its limbs are covered in various pieces of clothing, and the items usually correspond with the limbs they are on (i.e. arms in shirts and legs in pants).

SCP-8697 was a female human being, approximately 30 years old, with appearance and mannerisms identical to [EXPUNGED] at that age. It was discovered by the Department of Down during reclamation and expansion work at Area-86, buried two meters beneath the Director's Office (itself fifty meters below the surface of the Namib Desert). When sand was removed from its lungs, SCP-8697 became responsive.

SCP-8698 denotes an array of structures sporadically appearing beneath the Namib Desert in southern Africa. These range in temporal origin from the ancient world to nearly the present date, and in scale from single-person kiosks to vast commercial complexes.
No remains have ever been found within an SCP-8698 instance. Period documentation is typically present, with identifying information universally absent.

It is suspected that the city itself, due to its rich cultural and historic traditions, is directly responsible for this effect. Due to the size of the city and its population, containment has proved exceedingly difficult.

Vessels and aircraft affected by SCP-8711 reappear in coastal waters filled with extensive rock formations and reef prone shoals surrounding a large island landmass dubbed SCP-8711-1. This

SCP-8713 events are presented as live art performances. The content of each event is highly variable and consistently falls outside of what might be expected from such performances. Consistent factors of events include the presence of POI-8713, as well as witnesses being unable to conceive of concepts such as “horror”, “atrocity” and “bad art” for the duration. As a result, actions carried out as part of an SCP-8713 event are always received positively, regardless of societal or artistic merit.

SCP-8714 là một bộ sưu tập các hiện vật được thu hồi từ điền trang của cố Lãnh chúa Alexander Brandt III,2 tại Northumberland, Vương quốc Anh. Sau một sự cố hỏa hoạn thiêu rụi điền trang và giết chết Lãnh chúa Brand, bộ sưu tập SCP-8714 được phát hiện phía sau một cánh cửa bí mật trong tầng hầm của dinh thự.

SCP-8715 is a 1.23-litre, black ceramic vase of indeterminate origin. When any liquid is introduced into the object, it is anomalously diminished at a rate inconsistent with any known form of natural evaporation or absorption.

SCP-8716 is a digital anomaly capable of ontological displacement, whereby victims are displaced from baseline reality into a digital pocket universe. It targets individuals engaging with video sharing platforms. Manifestations are identified by the addition of "/theslugw1tch" in contaminated video URLs.

SCP-8717 is a fountain pen of luxury quality named “Libra”, housed in a mahogany gift box, using a standard piston converter made of reinforced glass to contain the ink.

SCP-8718 is an anomalous species of vine native to the Republic of South Africa suspected to be from the genus, Ceropegia. The species is currently unidentified, but is visually similar to Ceropegia ampliata.

SCP-8719 là một loại kí sinh trùng ức chế phản ứng sợ ở con người bằng cách tấn công hạch hạnh nhân và vùng dưới đồi. Dị thể sinh sản vô tính trong phần lớn động vật có vú, nhưng chỉ gây biến đổi hành vi với loài Homo sapiens. Các nguyên nhân lây nhiễm bao gồm tiếp xúc với máu, ghép nội tạng, và ăn thịt chưa nấu chín.

When observed by independent sapient subjects, SCP-8721's physical appearance will exhibit either male or female sex characteristics.

SCP-8723 refers to two objects found near the town of Caldes de Vall, in the Spanish Pyrenees. SCP-8723-1 is an exceptionally large skeleton of Capra Pyrenaica,3 measuring 10 meters long. SCP-8723-2 is a porcelain statue of a red cherub with four wings. It is believed to be the remnants of a destroyed paraweapon of unknown manufacture, absorbing 0.5 Akiva per minute. SCP-8723-2 is currently lodged into the neck of SCP-8723-1.

SCP-8732 is a worn 3x3x3 meter box composed of an indeterminate metal with a single plain door of similar composition on one face.
SCP-8733 is an Automatic Products Model 113 vending machine. It will dispense a human body once a week.

On this date, Hunt shot and killed Halsey in front of Halsey's house in Anne Arundel, Maryland, USA.1 A notebook with a thick, black cover was found in Hunt's possession immediately after the murder. SCP-8834 is a three-word Latin phrase capable of inducing remote hypnotism. Its behavioral vector is deployed when spoken at a marble bust depicting a living person, the target. The bust must have been sculpted by the speaker.

All five items were recovered from a studio formerly occupied by the movement and were the only remaining anartworks present; numerous other paintings and sculptures were found destroyed within the building. SCP-8978 describes random thaumaturgic activity initiated within river delta landforms. Colloquially known as "deltarunes," events are characterized by short but highly concentrated channelings of runic magic that will often fail, releasing large amounts of ambient EVE2 in the process. In the rare case of a successful channeling, the resulting effects can widely vary, but due to the inherently constrained ritual period, are often low in complexity and general impact.

SCP-8979 is a standard black cassette tape with a handwritten label reading "Unreleased Eazy-E Demo." It was recovered in ██████, California, during a covert Foundation operation in 20██. The cassette appears to contain previously unreleased recordings attributed to the late rapper Eric "Eazy-E" Wright, co-founder of N.W.A. However, when played on any standard audio device, the tape does not produce music, but instead summons SCP-8979-1.

SCP-8987 is a series of alleged anomalous occurrences and phenomena within the Red Brook Mine, located in Dutch Mountain, Pennsylvania. Information pertaining to SCP-8987 was leaked to the Foundation on 03/05/1966 by what appears to be an attempted whistleblower from Summit Anthracite, a Pennsylvanian coal company that has been in operation since 1952. The Red Brook Mine is the only mine owned by Summit Anthracite.
The POI who presented this information to the Foundation has yet to be identified

SCP-8990 further exhibits a probabilistic effect, leading to the inadvertent encounters of Noxin and Pressler in various places and environments, although this is capable of being interrupted by outside factors. Additionally, this effect prevents either individual from being killed.

SCP-9035 designates "Foundationland", the official SCP Foundation theme park, located in Fukuoka, Japan, and all anomalies contained within.

SCP-9036 is a phenomenon in which the SCP Foundation functions more efficiently and cohesively than is statistically plausible for such an organization. This includes but is not limited to appropriation of resources and personnel, bureaucratic organization, lack of corruption, lack of factionalism, response to crises (both active and proactive), ability to remain in good standing with and procure funding from numerous governments all around the world, and general efficacy of strategies devised b

SCP-9037 is partially an ideological complex existing within the noosphere (realm of human thought). SCP-9037’s complex is primarily constructed of anti-noospheric (realm outside of human thought) content, possibly of an alternate reality. This composition makes SCP-9037 incredibly unstable, as it contains abnormal and incompatible conceptual constructs. If completely isolated, SCP-9037 would collapse and release mass amounts of anomalous structures into the physical or metaphysical world. SCP-9

SCP-9038 refers to a volume of thaumaturgically engineered space. SCP-9038 originated from the research of a hypothesis that not all ectoentropic anomalies are actually ectoentropic; that some of them do not create (or eliminate) mass and energy from nowhere, but transfer mass and energy from (or to) another location within the universe and then transform them into the intended object.
Foundation cosmology research has proven that, given the large amount of matter generated by all ectoentropic a

SCP-9039 refers to a true crime podcast colloquially referred to as "A Perfect Crime Podcast", which covers murders while adding an often inaccurate paranormal tinge. Episodes of the Perfect Crime Podcast have been discovered in numerous websites, with the majority of sightings being on the Parawatch Wiki forums (See addendum 1). Attempts to trace the IP address of the podcast's host have so far been unsuccessful. There is few information available on the host—if such a host even exists—apart fr

SCP-9040 is the collective designation for a population of Blattella germanica:2 individually designated SCP-9040-01 through SCP-9040-53. Instances exhibit sapience, fluent vocal speech, anthropomorphic behavior, and significantly extended lifespans. All wear garments consistent with late-18th century European maritime fashion, typically accessorized with sewing needles in place of swords and miniature firecrackers in place of pistols.

SCP-9043 is a pair of socks, featuring a light brown and navy blue striped pattern.

SCP-9044 là một hành lang. SCP-9044 nằm bên trong một ngôi nhà ngoại ô tại số 8541 ███████ Lane, Virginia. Hiện Tổ Chức vẫn chưa tới được điểm cuối của SCP-9044. Việc mở cánh cửa nằm ở nơi được cho là điểm cuối của SCP-9044 chỉ dẫn tới một căn buồng đưa tới một cánh cửa khác. Có thể nghe thấy tiếng cào từ các khu vực khác trong nhà.
SCP-9044 được phát hiện lần đầu tiên sau khi toàn bộ gia đình nhà Lorey mất tích, theo giả định, sự kiện xảy ra khi các đối tượng đang mở tiệc tân gia. Tất cả 27 ngư

SCP-9045 is an anomalous retrocausal phenomenon by which unknown individuals (SCP-9045-1) appear within media and documentation (such as newspapers, photographs, birth certificates, and marriage licenses). Despite their appearance being near-identical to known individuals, the identities of these instances cannot be corroborated or confirmed by anyone1, beyond stating that they "look like someone they've seen before."
These unknown individuals (SCP-9045-1) manifest as depictions of those with al
SCP-9046 còn sống.

SCP-9047 is a male Cardigan Welsh corgi1 which is identical to any other dog of its breed, with the exception of its exceptional longevity and apparent total immunity to physical trauma and pathogens (whether anomalous or non-anomalous), rendering it incapable of carrying or transmitting any infectious agents. Besides this, SCP-9047 displays no unusual behavior, and exhibits standard behavioral responses to positive and negative stimuli—with the exception of exposure to pathogens or physical har

SCP-9048 is the collective designation for SCP-9048-1, “The Banksworth Theatre”, and SCP-9048-2 instances, individuals who have previously been exposed to a performance within SCP-9048-1. Every year, within one week of May 1st, SCP-9048-1 will manifest and draw in an audience to watch the upcoming performance. This occurrence has been designated as the "Ouroboros Event".
Through interviews of SCP-9048-2 instances, it has been determined that the Ouroboros Event consists of a play adaptation of t

SCP-9049 là giới hạn tổng số răng của loài người có thể tồn tại trên Trái Đất tại bất kỳ thời điểm nào. Giá trị chính xác của giới hạn này là chưa rõ, dù vậy thì ước tính rơi vào khoảng 7.0*10¹². Một khi tổng số răng của loài người chạm đến SCP-9049, sẽ không còn một chiếc răng mới nào phát triển. Điều này ảnh hưởng đến sự phát triển của răng sữa và răng vĩnh viễn cũng như các nguồn răng dị thường khác đã được biết. SCP-9049 đạt được lần đầu tiên vào ngày 19/10/2049, Tổng Số Răng (TSR) đã không

SCP-9051 is a 1 fluid ounce elliptical bottle labeled "Spa Therapy Shampoo". The fluid inside the bottle has been identified as identical to non-anomalous shampoo. The fluid within the bottle can be removed and used as shampoo. However, SCP-9051 can never be fully emptied.
When opened, SCP-9051 will also generate SCP-9051-A, an entity made out of same fluid inside SCP-9051 within a 3 meter spherical radius of its location. The entity is capable of emitting gurgling noises, but cannot move, speak

SCP-9052 refers to a week-long event of anomalous activity which took place at the gravesite of Zechariah Robinsons (PoI-9052-1). The gravestone of PoI-9052-1 will henceforth be referred to as SCP-9052-1. All anomalous activity at SCP-9052-1 took place over the time period of 1/22/201█ to 1/29/201█, periodically from 11:00 PM - 11:59 PM every day.


Gravestone of PoI-9052-1


SCP-9052-1 is located at Oakland Park Catholic Cemetery. SCP-9052-1 measures 1.1 m x 0.3 m x 0.1 m. SCP-9052-1 consists o

SCP-9053 designates an anomalous phenomenon affecting mannequins, dolls, and other imitations of humanity. These mannequins will often be observed engaging in behavior that suggests sapience and locomotion, often in a manner that is considered uncanny and threatening. All observed events have later been determined to have entirely mundane explanations, however the frequency at which these events occur still warrant investigation.

SCP-9054 is an extradimensional anomaly located in New York City, New York. Before its sudden collapse, SCP-9054 was an infinitely large industrial complex with non-Euclidean2 internal geometry. SCP-9054 was previously only accessible via an access tunnel in the city's subway system, and only in the presence of SCP-9054-1, henceforth referred to as Sr. Researcher Nicholas Feynman.
Due to his unique interaction with SCP-9054, Feynman was assigned as the team lead for the project. It quickly becam
SCP-9055 is a large, complex, subterranean structure located directly below Site-14.

SCP-9056 is an amorphous mass fluctuating between 1 and 2 meters in height which levitates approximately 1.5 meters off the ground at all times. Its surface constantly displays an ever-changing array of images, the meaning of which is currently unknown. The object is sentient and capable of telepathic communication within a range of 5 meters.

SCP-9057 is a phenomenon that interferes in the perception of an individual's speech. It does not have an effect on non-verbal methods of communication. Anyone hearing this altered speech will perceive it as uninteresting in both content and delivery. Due to this perception being subjective, different individuals will perceive this speech in different ways. Individuals afflicted with SCP-9057 are not affected in this way, but suffer from other effects, including:

persistent, mild forgetfulness.

SCP-9058 là một con mèo nhà đực trưởng thành; nặng 4,9 kg, có bộ lông màu đen và đã được triệt sản. Mặc dù SCP-9058 có vẻ khỏe mạnh và bình thường về mặt di truyền cũng như giải phẫu, dị thể chưa từng được quan sát thấy phát ra bất kỳ tiếng kêu nào.
SCP-9059 is an event involving two human subjects, designated SCP-9059-FINDER and SCP-9059-SEEKER.

SCP-9060 refers to a viral cognitohazardous phenomenon that causes a person (designated SCP-9060-1) to enter a violent state when their full face is viewed by another human (designated SCP-9060-2), whether directly, via video recording, photography, or on social media platforms.
SCP-9060-1 instances will display signs of emotional distress, including crying, screaming and incoherent speech, as they pursue SCP-9060-2. Subjects will only move in a straight line toward their target, regardless of p

SCP-9061 was a Charlie I class nuclear submarine, manufactured by the USSR at some point between 1967 and 1969. SCP-9061's hull was completely black, lacking any of the typical markings found on other vessels of the same class. SCP-9061 was capable of autonomous movement, as well as travelling at speeds and depths far greater than what its structure should have been capable of.
SCP-9061 would typically keep to depths between 800m and 1000m, making tracking difficult. However, it would occasional

SCP-9062 is a cube-like structure, hypothesised to exist in a higher dimensional plane than our own. Its standard size is 9 x 9 x 9 metres, though has been observed to shrink to as small as 2 x 2 x 2 millimetres, and expand as large as 30 x 30 x 30 metres. There is no known upper or lower limits to how much it can alter its size.
SCP-9062 is capable of off-ground levitation - most often suspending itself in-place in the air as it changes its size - though typically rests on the ground. The reaso

SCP-9063 is a series of abnormal fatalities occurring in and around the unincorporated community of Pemberton, Texas. As of Foundation recording, no cause for these fatalities has been established, nor have the conditions for such an anomaly to occur been identified. As of writing, the last SCP-9063 incident occurred on October 20, 2024.
The population of Pemberton has decreased to 26 as of the 2020 US census. Independent Foundation figures predict population figures further decreasing, and a se
SCP-9064 là tác nhân phản truyền nhận thức "UNDERKILL" (AM-68-1) do Tổ Chức phát triển.

SCP-9065 is an ectoparasitic2 organism resembling a pair of light grey athleisure-style sweatpants3. The organism's exterior is similar in texture and appearance to a standard cotton/polyester material. The interior of the pants is similarly non-anomalous in appearance, and it is currently unknown how the organism keeps its teeth concealed when not feeding. Genetic testing has revealed similarities to Haemopis terrestris, also known as the American terrestrial leech. This, combined with the pres

SCP-9066 là một sự hiện diện mờ nhạt giống người được cảm nhận liên tục bởi toàn bộ nhân loại từ sự xuất hiện ban đầu của nó. SCP-9066 không phải là một vật thể rắn, thực thể, địa điểm, hay hiện tượng, nó chỉ tồn tại dưới dạng một trải nghiệm thuần tuý với toàn bộ nhân loại. Nó luôn được miêu tả là một hình người với chiều cao trung bình, khoả thân, không có tóc, không có các đặc điểm nhận dạng và vô tính. Không thể giải thích cho các dạng sống không phải con người về SCP-9066. Dù có những sự mâ

SCP-9067 là mã định danh cho một hệ thống vũ khí sử dụng hệ thống khoá mục tiêu đo lường ý niệm theo ngữ cảnh, và sử dụng các chuyển động phi Ơ-clit 4 chiều để vận chuyển tải trọng. SCP-9067 có khả năng nhắm vào các cá nhân dựa theo các kí hiệu linh quyển học chứa 3 hoặc nhiều hơn 3 dấu hiệu ngữ nghĩa. Phiên bản hiện tại của dị thể đã được tinh chỉnh cho các dòng drone SKYEYE, EVILEYE và BIG SKY của Tổ Chức.
Mô-đun ICT đã bắt đầu được phát triển vào năm 1963, trước khi đã bị cho ngưng hoạt động

SCP-9068 là hiện tượng cháy rừng trong trí quyển. Dị thể được coi là hiện tượng tự nhiên trong trí quyển, những vụ "cháy rừng" này có chức năng phá huỷ và xoá bỏ các mảnh vụn đã tích tụ trong tâm trí tập thể của chúng ta. Theo giả quyết, SCP-9068 hoạt động tương tự với các đám cháy ảnh hưởng đến rừng tại thực tại cơ sở thông qua lửa sinh thái học: khi các khái niệm đang hình thành hoặc phai mờ xuất hiện tích tụ và kết hợp trong trí quyển thành các từ khoá như "khô", "nứt", "có thể cháy." SCP-9070 was an explosion of thaumaturgic energy that originated from eastern Qeqqeta, Greenland at 11:23 UTC on the 26th of June, 2025. It expanded to an estimated radius of 200,000 to 350,000 kilometers from its point of origin and passed through most materials without resistance. It fully permeated through Earth at a point approximately 400-500 kilometers north of Concordia Station, Antarctica 1 minute and 32 seconds after its manifestation.

SCP-9071 là một tờ giấy in khổ 21x27 cm được ép plastic, có in hình một lồng gà con ở một mặt. Mặt còn lại trống. Khi SCP-9071 được gắn lên một bề mặt bằng bất kỳ cách nào, mọi sinh vật hữu tri nhìn thấy nó sẽ bị thuyết phục rằng SCP-9071 không phải là một tờ giấy in ép plastic, mà là một cái lồng thật chứa đầy gà con sống.
Các đối tượng quan sát sẽ sẽ phản ứng với SCP-9071 như thể các kích thích tương ứng thực sự hiện diện, mô tả mùi, âm thanh, chuyển động, và hành vi của từng con gà con một cá

SCP-9072 refers to a humanoid entity that has the appearance of a male human's shadow. From observations, the entity is believed to be 1.7 m (67 inches) tall, and locomotion occurs via silent levitation. Attempts at identifying the entity through thermal camera footage have failed, as the entity appears to emit no body heat.
The entity manifests between 11:00 PM and 6:30 AM local time, on all days of the year aside from the 10th of October. During manifestations, SCP-9072's movement patterns hav

SCP-9074 is a wooden wardrobe measuring 2.1 meters in height and constructed from dark-stained oak. Examination indicates the object was manufactured in the late 19th century, engraved on the back with the name “Marsha J.”. The interior appears ordinary when unoccupied.
When an individual enters SCP-9074 and closes its doors, they disappear for a period ranging from 1 to 15 minutes. Upon exiting, subjects exhibit a physical or symbolic manifestation of a deeply concealed aspect of their identity

SCP-9075 is the collective designation for the various ongoing phenomena affecting Postojna, Slovenia and its residents in the years since the 2077 Kresnik Chemical Plant Disaster. These phenomena center around the potential contamination of the town’s water supply and are believed to originate from one of the locations most severely impacted by the chemical plant’s total destruction — the depths of Postojna Cave.

Once the phenomena becomes active, the mahjong tile set in use will be spontaneously modified to accommodate the new rulings. All players become immediately aware of all rule changes, without the need of further clarification.

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-9078 is a common raven1 partially domesticated as part of a bird training program run in the city of Swansea, Wales. During this program, SCP-9078 was given the pet name "basketball"[sic] by its handlers.

SCP-9079 is a large language model-based consumer A.I. chatbot created by MithTech, a Silicon Valley tech startup founded in 2019 by C.E.O. Milo November.1 SCP-9079 functions similarly to non-anomalous A.I. tools like ChatGPT or Google Gemini in that users input text-based prompts and SCP-9079 uses a predictive algorithm to generate responses.
When individuals read responses generated by SCP-9079, they will immediately believe that any information presented by SCP-9079 is factual. When asked to

SCP-9080 is the collective designation for a continuous series of handwritten letters that arrive without postmarks, stamps, or return addresses.1 Letters are uniformly written with blue ballpoint ink on lined paper and wrapped in envelopes made of construction paper.
To date, no discernible pattern has been found across recipients, as instances have been delivered worldwide to civilians across a wide range of demographics with no apparent connection to one another. However, each recipient has o

SCP-9081 is the designation for a series of cigarette packets created and distributed by GoI-006 ("The Factory") through anomalous means. Packets of SCP-9081 manifest spontaneously on shelves alongside standard tobacco products in retail locations worldwide. Analysis of the cigarettes has revealed nothing substantial, as they are largely identical to their non-anomalous counterparts.
The properties of SCP-9081 manifest when all the cigarettes in a given packet are consumed by a single individual

Said live-streams consist entirely of static shots of interiors; examples include basements, classrooms, bathrooms, kitchens, church halls, and bedrooms. data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-9084 là mã định danh cho một sự thật không tồn tại, nó không hề là thật, và có liên quan tới một sự kiện không hề xảy ra.

SCP-9085 là một căn bệnh không rõ nguồn gốc với khả năng lây lan thông qua một danh sách dài các thói quen. Hiện vẫn chưa rõ bản chất của SCP-9085 là do virus, vi khuẩn hay nấm. Mặc dù việc tiếp xúc là con đường lây nhiễm phổ biến nhất khiến một cá nhân mắc phải SCP-9085, có một tỉ lệ nhỏ nhưng có ý nghĩa thống kê của các trường hợp cho thấy đã có những người mắc phải bệnh từ khi mới được sinh ra.
Dưới đây là danh sách không đầy đủ về các hoạt động có thể gây nhiễm SCP-9085:

SCP-9086 appears to be an Intel Paragon supercomputer that has fallen into disrepair, resembling systems produced by Intel in the 1990s. SCP-9086 was acquired during a foundation raid on an abandoned building located near Cambridge, Massachusetts, following the spread of rumors regarding the existence of a previously undocumented supercomputer on deep web forums. SCP-9086 contained a program designated "Mira". Analysis suggests the "Mira" program could have been used to host and execute an advan

SCP-9087 manifests as street art depicting a humanoid-animal hybrid with irisless, pupilless eyes and an open mouth. SCP-9087 is capable of manifesting upon any exterior surface in metropolitan areas across the world. SCP-9087 is chemically identical to aerosol paint, being easily erased by standard removal methods.
Upon making visual contact with SCP-9087, any individual who has previously suffered a second-trimester miscarriage or stillbirth will be compelled to submerge themself in an open bo

SCP-9088 is a room located within Site-19 on an abandoned sublevel. The room measures 2 x 4 x 3 meters. It is made of concrete, and the walls are painted a light beige. Despite a lack of routine maintenance, the room is mostly free of dust, mold, and contaminants.
No red objects can be inside or within the bounds of the SCP-9088 room. This is an intrinsic property of the area that has so far tested to be inviolable. It is currently unclear as to how or why SCP-9088 cannot have red objects in it,
Con hẻm là một con hẻm có một danh sách hạn chế nghiêm ngặt các sự thật được gán cho nó, có thể được dùng để mô tả dị thể.
SCP-9090 is an organic humanoid standing at 1.98 meters and weighing 67.8 kilograms. It displays limited motor control, but is believed to be sentient and aware of its surroundings.

SCP-9091 là mã định danh cho một thiết bị dị thường mang hình dạng của một dây thòng lọng thô và một chiếc máy tính lượng tử tổng hợp cơ học với khả năng tạo ra phản vật chất. Giả thuyết chỉ ra rằng SCP-9091 có nguồn gốc cách ít nhất 14 tỉ năm ánh sáng kể từ hệ Mặt trời. Dị thể ban đầu được phát hiện tại Jerrusalem vào 14/02/2023 trong cuộc khai quật khảo cổ định kì. Mục đích của dị thể vẫn chưa được biết. Dị tính của SCP-9091 biểu hiện tùy thuộc vào các điều kiện kích hoạt khác nhau, thường gây
SCP-9092 is an ornamental snow globe that measures 2.8m in diameter. Its pedestal and casing are made of ordinary marble and glass.

SCP-9093 refers to Righteous Justice, a crime fiction television program that airs exclusively within the Greater Utica Area. At any time, it may manifest itself and commandeer an existing broadcasting station, after which the station will only air SCP-9093. If SCP-9093 is not removed from a commandeered broadcast station for over three hours, it will manifest on local streaming services, making removal significantly more difficult.
SCP-9093’s source is impossible to geolocate, and may only be r

SCP-9094 refers to a social media website known as “Petafox.com”. SCP-9094 is hidden from the general public and is only accessible by sapient artificial intelligences. While a Foundation web sweep was able to discover the website, all that is accessible to those who do not fit the criteria is a picture depicting the avatar of the website’s founder, a sapient artificial intelligence known as Vixen (dubbed SCP-9094-1), alongside options prompting the user to either 'sign in' or 'create an account

SCP-9095 is an anomalous website, titled "Victims of VKTM Memorial Foundation", presumably originating from and maintained by Vikander-Kneed Technical Media (GOI-5889). SCP-9095 can be taken offline with no unusual difficulty, but, since its discovery, a new iteration has reliably been identified within 5-10 days of removal. No infohazardous properties have been observed, but there is evidence that accessing the site may cause an individual to become more open to suggestion, more trusting of the

SCP-9096 is a phenomenon where food left in the Site-96 break room disappears

when unobserved. Food left unobserved in this way disappears inconsistently, with no currently known pattern. The type of food also seems to affect the chance of disappearance, as sugary or meaty foods disappear much more often, and soybean-based foods appear to be unaffected.

SCP-9097 refers to a collection of circular pills of bright pink coloring. SCP-9097 has no label, but the back holds a logo for GOI-4319 "Just Girly Things".
SCP-9098 was an anomalous sentient broadcast signal that was neutralized on 11/12/1996 by SCP-9098-B

SCP-9099 is a concrete silo approximately seventy-five meters in diameter and two hundred and twenty-five meters in height, located approximately seventy kilometers northeast of ████████, Siberia. Though it came under Foundation control after the fall of the Soviet Union, it is not known if it was originally created by the Soviets, as all pertinent GRU-P records were destroyed prior to their dissolution.

SCP-9100 is an anomaly speculated to account for rapid mental health decline in a subset of the Akron, OH population immediately following the 2014 Akron mid-air disaster. Affected individuals, primarily senior citizens, become convinced they have "skipped" several decades of their life, with no memory of the intervening years.

The duration of missing time varies between subjects, averaging 35 years.
The whereabouts of every subject during the relevant time periods are accounted for.

SCP-9101 is Edmund Watts, a 52-year-old repairman who is apparently incapable of remaining within any dynamic for an extended period of time. This effect extends to specific locations, relationships, and states of being. While SCP-9101 is capable of using its ability directly, the effect may also manifest when SCP-9101 is unconscious, distracted, or otherwise unable to provide direct input.1
"The thousand injuries of Fortunato I had borne as best I could, but when he ventured upon insult I vowed revenge."2

SCP-9104 is a fissure in the ground at Site-109's main warehouse, approximately 0.93m in size. It does not pose any threat to base-level normalcy or living organisms, nor does it expand in size. It is unambiguously a regular crack in the floor, constituting no danger at all, that maintenance at the Site has delayed fixing (due to plain indolence).

SCP-9106 operates similarly to a non-anomalous real estate company, but specifically targets anomalous properties, structures and locations for the purposes of acquiring, refurbishing and selling them. It is noted that SCP-9106 exclusively targets locations featuring artificial or manufactured structures.

Instances of SCP-9109 have no tactile influence of any forces around it (such as gravity or air). Though, instances may be entered leading to the participating entity exiting the Universe, resulting in its destruction.

SCP-9110 is the sudden disappearance of David Thompson (POI-9110), which occurred on 03/05/2025.
The unusual circumstances surrounding the event prompted a joint investigation by the UIU and FIIC,1 and resulted in the subsequent classification as an anomaly. A full timeline and an overview of the investigation has been included in this file.2

SCP-9111 is a device that consists of an ontological abstraction-reification machine and a small mobile controller that allows remote access to the aforementioned machine.

Testing of these abilities are not considered a necessary function of the Foundation, and as such have been indefinitely halted per General Order 05-LIMITATION-Q2.

SCP-9113 is a phenomenon that affects visual artworks upon their perceived completion by the author, wherein any attempt to substantially alter the contents of the piece will fail. Although additions and subtractions are possible, any element conflicting with the initial intent cannot be artistically expressed.

SCP-9114 is an animate 15th-century suit of plated armour, approximately 1.75 m in height. Its construction and ornamentation match armaments from midland regions of the Holy Roman Empire. Despite lacking a gambeson or internal framework, all components remain suspended and articulate as though worn by a human body. Individual plates can be removed but autonomously return to their correct positions once released.

SCP-9115 is the collective designation for an unknown quantity of visually indistinct stones. Despite no evident memetic, compulsory, or mind-altering anomalous properties, SCP-9115 instances have been utilized in an unusually high quantity of violent incidents, in particular violent incidents affecting minors in the contiguous United States.
All known instances of SCP-9115 appear to have originated in Dearborn, Michigan, separated from a larger rock by a chain gang in late 1932. It is likely th

SCP-9116 is Annapurna I, a massif in the Himalayas located between the Marshyangdi River and Pokhara Valley. All life that reaches a freezing point whilst above an altitude of ~7,500 meters on SCP-9116 will remain perfectly preserved via prolonged cryogenic stasis.

SCP-9117 is a small ceramic teapot with various engravings upon its surface. When static, these engravings resemble 15th century Arabic calligraphy, although the characters do not correspond to any known extinct or modern language. The teapot is worn, and has several cracks around its rim which prevents a lid from being placed on it.

Members of SCP-9119 display atypical behavior where various processes of the colony are used in unproductive or actively detrimental ways. This includes the creation of unnecessary rooms within the colony, the storage of small amounts of food, eggs, and detritus within those rooms, and hyper-aggression toward ants not part of SCP-9119.

SCP-9121 was an astronomical event that occurred above the town of Beddington, Maine, on April 6, 2025. The event itself was an unnatural solar eclipse that lasted approximately an hour and a half. During this eclipse, entities hereon referred to as SCP-9121-1 were made visible.

SCP-9122 is a looped radio signal operating in the high-frequency range, observed at ██GHz, an encrypted channel formerly reserved for Foundation operations only. How SCP-9122 accessed the channel is currently unknown. SCP-9122 is extrasolar1 in origin, with its exact broadcast location unknown. The transmission itself consists of dialogue in an unintelligible alien language lasting exactly four minutes and thirty-two seconds in length. SCP-9123 refers to a humanoid entity previously described by the Foundation as PoI-99123, a.k.a “Dorian Cillian Sloan”. Its primary anomalous ability is producing verbal commands capable of compelling sapient subjects to perform actions against their own wills. SCP-9124 is a shared condition wherein blood is able to pass between victims. It is known to afflict seven women, four of which have been identified conclusively. Despite the lack of physical connection between the victims, substances injected into one will appear in the bloodstream of the others some time later, ranging from minutes to weeks, and the heartbeats of each victim can be faintly detected in the others. SCP-9125 is the root of human unreason.
SCP-9126 is an anomalous subspecies of the ichneumon wasp Podogaster Cactorum. SCP-9126 instances appear identical to their non-anomalous counterparts, and behave mostly identically as well.

SCP-9127 is a 75 cm long bansuri2 made out of a single long shaft of bamboo, featuring six holes for playing. The embouchure is made of ivory and has been tied with a thin thread to prevent cracking. SCP-9127 is adorned with jewels, which display no anomalous effects. SCP-9128 là một cuốn sách có tựa đề cuốn sách về vạn vật bởi dado. SCP-9128 có số trang vô hạn mặc cho kích thước bên ngoài của dị thể. SCP-9128 là một cuốn từ điển chứa tất cả tổ hợp các chữ cái có thể có và định nghĩa của chúng.

SCP-9129 is an abnormally large humanoid skeleton discovered in the Sakai Scrub Natural Area. It is interred upright, with its upper half exposed. Before containment, the remains were overgrown with crossvine. The ribcage has been distended by a massive, empty wasp's nest. Layered white stains under the orbital and nasal cavities are attributed to bird feces. The bones remain connected in the absence of ligaments. The flesh has entirely decayed.
Approaching SCP-9129 with the intent to touch it r

SCP-9130 is an effect that transforms members of the Coniferous and Deciduous2 groups of trees into SCP-9130-1 instances. 9130-1 instances have an increased metabolism and growth rate, which appear at first to be ectoentropic in nature, but actually drains from the surrounding reality for nutrition. SCP-9130-1 instances measurably have a lower Hume reading than baseline, indicating that they are acting as a constant reality sink. SCP-9131 is the collective designation for an unknown number of objects possessing enclosed spaces. Extensive testing has revealed that the material composition of SCP-9131 instances can only be altered from matter inside the instance.

SCP-9132 is a small hardbound book of an indeterminate number of pages. No title or similarly recognizable clues to signify an author or origin are present with its cover otherwise depicting an encircled hexagram through iron rivets. The leather used in SCP-9132's binding is composed from several disparate animal sources, including Bos taurus, Equus ferus caballus, Capra hircus, Homo sapiens, and Panthera leo1. SCP-9133 is a beach ball, possessing a low density. Despite this, the object is negatively buoyant.

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-9135 is a highly organized cloud with a rain-free base, wall cloud, and anvil top. It should be noted that SCP-9135 is currently intensifying into a supercell thunderstorm.

SCP-9136 is a wheelchair that is able to move autonomously, requiring no maintenance, and which can manifest small quantities of alcohol, cigarettes, or other illicit substances in its folds and pockets. It has a high degree of situational awareness regarding its surroundings and immediate context, using that information to navigate itself towards individuals using mobility devices.

SCP-9138 is the newly dominant moral framework of the universe as of 25/06/1950. It selects sapient souls considered exceptional by their peers, distinguishing them primarily by their tomb decorations and grave-goods. Souls so recognised by their community are sorted into a variety of paradisiacal afterlives which reflect their actions while living. These afterlives embody SCP-9138-A’s ethical and aesthetic values, and are structured to reward and further perpetuate such behaviour.

SCP-9139 is Foundation Team Lead Malkinder Singh Chattha, age 26, who experiences a constant state of disequilibrium unaffected by medications and therapy. Extensive imagery, both anomalous and nonanomalous, has displayed no expected internal physiological explanation. Instead, SCP-9139 exerts an uncontrollable, mild reality-bending effect on itself that perpetually affects its sense of balance.

Its principal component (designated SCP-9140-1) is a carved stone statue, measuring 12.5cm in height. The statue resembles the figure of a pregnant woman, with glyphs carved around its circumference. Above the carvings, there is a groove carved into the stone, measuring 0.7cm in width and 0.5cm in depth.

SCP-9141 is an umbrella term referring to all minor curses placed onto the Foundation. There are currently 37 active curses and 8957 in the history of SCP-9141’s written record.2

SCP-9142 is a collective designation for a colony of four sapient rodents capable of producing an HUME-Degradation pheromone.1 This anomalous pheromone only manifests following the consumption of Mentha cunninghamii2 leaves. SCP-9142 will produce their HUME-Degradation pheromone for approximately two hours following activation, after which no anomalous traits can be observed. The properties of SCP-9145 only take effect when it is utilized by a subject between the ages of 4 and 11 years old. Drawings made using SCP-9145 will typically manifest as entities designated SCP-9145-A.

All examined instances of SCP-9147 exhibit specialized digestive tracts and are incapable of ingesting anything other than human flesh. Any deviations in diet have resulted in severe nausea, vomiting, and involuntary muscle spasms.

Subjects infected with SCP-9149 become obsessed with celebrating the Christmas holiday and will alter their behavior and routines to center completely around activities associated with Christmas, even if they do not celebrate the holiday or possess Christian beliefs.

Every instance of the fruit, henceforth referred to as SCP-9151-B, possesses an anomalous property that moves it autonomously, pushing it to combine with another SCP-9151-B instance from the same crop. This process is known as SCP-9151-C and it lasts anywhere from a second to an hour. Afterwards, the two SCP-9151-B instances become indistinguishable from a non-anomalous orange.

For unknown reasons, the entity is only able to manifest on Earth once per year on September 24th. Manifestations are typically fairly brief, with the longest recorded manifestation lasting for 7 minutes. When a pair of SCP-9161 are worn, a neurological link between the shoes and the wearer is formed so that any damage to the shoe manifests as a temporary lesion of the brain at a topographically corresponding site. SCP-9165 is a tall, humanoid entity approximately 1.9 meters tall, referred to as "Indrid Cold." The entity is dressed formally, wearing a suit or coat and pants made of the same unknown material. The entity is known to teleport and appear in multiple locations at once. SCP-9165 is described by exposed personnel to be visually intimidating even when viewed from a distance. SCP-9165 is known to communicate through telepathy.

The other 34 houses on Gorse Avenue are similar in style and further details have been omitted from this report due to their non-anomalous nature. Tất cả các phiên bản của SCP-9311 đều hoàn toàn giống hệt nhau, được chế tạo từ hỗn hợp thép mạ niken, cao su lưu hoá, gốm sứ, thuỷ tinh, nhựa, và một lượng nhỏ vật liệu nhựa không xác định và không còn được sử dụng trong thương mại.
SCP-9311 rất khó để tóm tắt mà không cần so sánh. SCP-9311 có một số đặc điểm giống với:

một dụng cụ thí nghiệm,

The SCP-9312 phenomenon refers to an oddity recorded by the fortune-telling and occult community several times since the 1990s. For the majority of its recorded existence, it was dismissed as a negative visualization or imitation of notable prophecies. With the advent of the internet and the easier access to communication that came from it, SCP-9312's existence would shift from an occasional mention to a source of debate for occultists and mediums in online forums.

SCP-9313 refers to a CRT television set that fails to display when powered on. Despite this, individuals who look upon the screen of SCP-9313 will claim the item does function, and is tuned to an out-of-service channel. This anomalous effect can be neutralized through resistance to psionic influence or by assuring oneself of their juvenescence.

SCP-9314 is, allegedly, the personal office of the Administrator. According to assorted rumors and institutional folklore, the office is located on one of Site-19's abandoned sublevels, but anyone who finds it can only do so once. These same stories claim that a person who enters the office may ask the Administrator a single question about the Foundation, which he will answer fully and honestly.
Though stories about SCP-9314 have circulated among the personnel of Site-19 at least since the year

SCP-9315 is an apple pie measuring 30 centimeters in diameter that possesses the ability to transmute other forms of matter into itself through direct contact. The transmutated material retains the same properties as the original anomaly, allowing the anomaly to "spread" at a exponential rate. No upper bound on this rate of conversion is known to exist.

SCP-9316 is an approximation of the London Natural History Museum, located exactly 1km below the original. Whilst originally regarded as part of SCP-1678, recent findings have warranted for it to receive its own item number.

SCP-9460 possesses a distinct interest in competitive wrestling.

SCP-9461 is a wooden door knob, similar to ones found in residential homes in much of Europe and North America. Its anomalous properties manifest when affixed to a door, wherein the property the door resides in (henceforth referred to as SCP-9461-2) will, within 10 minutes of SCP-9461 being affixed, be subject to summary demolition through various means. However, the door, door hinge, flooring, supports, and anything else that keeps the door SCP-9461 is affixed to standing will remain undamaged.

SCP-9463 is a circular lake surrounded by dirt with a radius of approximately seventeen (17) meters and a depth of three (3) fathoms. Although the composition of the liquid present in the lake was initially unknown, research has revealed that the liquid contains distilled water, potassium ions (K+), and hydroxide ions (OH-), indicating the former presence of potassium hydroxide (KOH). The solution has been observed to “attempt” to preserve the exact proportion of contents in the body at the same
SCP-9465 is a spacecraft designated the ITV1 Ouroboros, capable of exit and re-entry between timelines.

SCP-9466 collectively refers to 8 poems written in Younger Futhark on Norwegian spruce wax reading tablets, designated SCP-9466-1 through -8. The contents of each SCP-9466 instance detail the Norwegian perspective of the Battle of Stamford Bridge at varying time stages, including events that occurred before and after the conflict, following the same linear timeline. Despite their age, each reading tablet is physically whole and fully intelligible, with only minor chipping and surface scratches i

SCP-9469 is a 13 acre lot located in Santee, California. It previously served as a drive-in movie theater for 32 years until its closure in 1999. In 2002, newly installed CCTV cameras captured an activation of SCP-9469's paranormalities. The land was subsequently purchased from the original owners1 by the Department of Land Management.

Specifically, it is a set of complex but deterministic relationships between an enormous variety of biomechanical behaviours across different individuals. For example, the half-life of histamine in any one individual’s bloodstream can be used to compute any other’s peristaltic frequency. SCP-9480 is a hollow missile-shaped object measuring roughly 10 x 10 x 50 metres composed largely of graphite and diamond. The interior of SCP-9480 is mostly empty, barring a structure loosely resembling a bookshelf along the eastern wall and an additional structure at the rear. This bookshelf-esque structure contains a series of tablets desginated SCP-9480-A. SCP-9481 is an immobile accumulation of discarded thought-stuff known as an "egocache." Though SCP-9481 instances do not appear to possess any abnormal qualities, the increasing prevalence of oneiric geocaching has made them a subject of interest.1

SCP-9484 refers to the disassembled components of a toroidal stainless steel apparatus with a major radius of 5.5 meters and a minor radius of 0.4 meters. While active, SCP-9484 has a deleterious effect on the stability of the space-time continuum in a 20km radius spherical region around itself. SCP-9485 are a group of unfertilized inert eggs with a radius of 150-600km, found in various locations in the outer Solar System and resembling ordinary celestial objects. A total of 6 instances are known to exist, all beyond the orbit of Jupiter. More are likely to exist elsewhere.

During SCP-9487, the sleeping psyche of the affected subject (hereafter "host") finds itself in a space (or sequence of spaces) containing vignettes depicting past significant events in the host's life.

According to reports, SCP-9490 began during the middle of January, 2025; since that time, the five individuals have physically transformed.

SCP-9497 refers to anomalies associated with GoI-04971, a record label based in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

SCP-9498 is a phenomena where rips in space unobservable by the naked eye spontaneously appear. When an organism or object passes through an SCP-9498 instance, they will be transported to SCP-9498-1. SCP-9498 instances occur more frequently on highways. The reason for this is unknown. As most SCP-9498 instances last under a dozen seconds, the chances of a vehicle passing through one is much higher in locations such as highways due to the speed at which the vehicle moves. SCP-9499 can affect the currently living, but tends to manifest its traits during birth. SCP-9499 does not involve any sort of passing of the soul of one person to another.

SCP-9500 is a hypothetical cognitive block preventing the majority of Homo sapiens sapiens from recognizing the existence of paranormal phenomena.

The reason I did all that was because I was terrified that he'd graduate before me. He was a wonder kid: hardly tried and still got high marks. I had to have something over him. Something that made me better. Anyways, I ended up skipping my junior year. The college conversation began in the house. Mom and Dad didn't have enough money to send both of us to a big college. The deli had been struggling ever since people started leaving the city, so they had to choose one of us.

SCP-9502 targets members who display significant negative emotions regarding their past actions. Targeted members (designated SCP-9502-1s) typically lose their mental faculties within 3-6 months.

SCP-9503's blades feature performance-focused thaumaturgical manipulation, enhancing the user's execution of figure skating elements and techniques such as:

Often, liquids are strictly forbidden within the areas where Dr. Lassen performs his duties, yet he insists that the instances "have a right to be present," suggesting that the anomaly may possess a compulsion effect.

SCP-9505 is a group of four entities which have manifested on multiple occasions inside Foundation sites. The entities have been designated SCP-9505-1, -2, -3, and -4. During manifestations, they emit electromagnetic interference which causes video footage and sound recordings to distort and become unclear.
SCP-9507-D was a series of anomalous avian phenomena affecting the musician and Twitch livestreamer Vincent ████████1.

SCP-9508 is the pit at Open Mouth BBQ, a barbecue restaurant in Dripping Springs, TX. Prior to containment, Open Mouth BBQ was held in high regard by the local population. Its proprietorship changed on several occasions during its 41-year lifespan; none of the owners appear to have been aware of SCP-9508's anomaly.

SCP-9512 are a group of transient souls on the path through reincarnation who have deviated from their course. They were slain en masse, at the Red Sand5, and were able to maintain their spiritual weapons and aurelic bodies upon death. Rather than surrender to celestial authority, they continued as a group, and seized control of the Iron Citadel within the Hell of Resurrection6.

Object is an extremophilic species of yeast, capable of partially fermenting any liquid it exists in via enigmatic chemical means.

SCP-9520 is a spheroid mass of photosynthetic, cephalopod-like tentacles. It is capable of mimicking the appearance of other entities by self-transfiguration; while mostly identical, these mimics will possess a varying number of imperfections, such as suckers and geometric patterns where limbs, eyes, and/or other external organs would be.

SCP-9522 có ý thức, khả năng tư duy và trí thông minh vượt trội, đồng thời có thể phát hiện ý định lừa dối. Ngoài ra, SCP-9522 có thể nhận biết niềm tin, ý định và thông tin mà người tương tác đang cố tình che giấu. Chưa ghi nhận trường hợp lừa dối thành công SCP-9522.
Điều này không có nghĩa là SCP-9522 toàn tri.

SCP-9523 is a lake situated in the southwest of the Czech Republic. Analysis of sampled water indicates the lake contains no organic life and lacks the necessary nutrients to support a lake ecosystem. The soil around the lake's sides shows a low level of nutrient density.

SCP-9527 was discovered by a Foundation expedition beneath the Antarctic ice sheet, within a permanently enclosed saltwater lake cavity formed by a geological anomaly. No visible entrance to the cavity exists.

SCP-9529 is a domestic cat (Felis catus). The bottom half part of SCP-9529, comprising its four paws, half of its belly and the base of its tail, is missing. However, the interior of its abdominal cavity is invisible through the cross-section and the absence of its bottom body does not lead to any physiological problems.

The interior of SCP-9530 constitutes a pocket dimension of unknown size, though generally manifesting as a set of rooms that would be expected of a skyscraper or equivalent urban building, extending upwards to an undetermined distance. The first aspect of the anomaly is in effect from sundown until sunrise. SCP-9543 instances vary in size and color—most instances have been observed to be either orange, brown, black, or white—though all maintain a compact, rounded structure. Though this form frequently varies in height, build, hair colour, sex, and ethnicity, it always wears a black business suit, white shirt, black clip-on tie, black dress shoes, black sunglasses, black leather gloves, and an earpiece with the cable fitted into the collar.

SCP-9546 resembles a worn sock puppet with brown button eyes and a crudely stitched mouth. Numerous sections of the fabric have been repaired with mismatched patchwork. SCP-9546 wears a miniature jester costume and emits a persistent smell of decomposition. Unidentified stains are present along the lower portion of the object.

SCP-9547 is an anomalous immune response created when individuals come into contact with anomalous materials, hereafter referred to as "triggers". An individual that displays an SCP-9547 response to one trigger may not display it for others. While exact numbers are not known, it is estimated that SCP-9547 is displayed by around 2% of the human population.

SCP-9549 is an anomalous location masquerading as SCP Foundation Area-45. There are two facilities presently responding to this designation, both equipped with a Director and small support staff, but Foundation records attest to the construction of only one. Due to a suspicious loss of electronic documentation, it is not known which facility is legitimate and which is not.

One lobe is highly asymmetrical, consisting primarily of computing components and a variety of communications or observation devices, including a UHF radio antenna and magnetometer boom. SCP-9592 is a standard black Sharpie-branded marker, indistinguishable from non-anomalous items of the same brand.
SCP-9593 is Prestige TeeVee, a limited television series produced by the Totleighsoft Entertainment Division and written by Daniel Enforcement.

The World Trade Center complex is architecturally larger than in the prior iteration.
The civilian and structural casualty count exceeds the prior iteration by a factor between 1.4 and 2.8.

SCP-9597 denotes a series of texts, online advertisements, email spam, mail spam, and phone calls experienced in reference to the “insect shower.”

SCP-9598 is a sapient, 54-meter-tall tornado situated on Clare Island, Ireland. SCP-9598 self-identifies as Taranis, a minor god and the personification of weather and storms in Gaelic mythology. Due to the lack of historical documentation on Taranis, this claim has not and likely can not be verified.

Instruments needed to assemble the table include a Phillips-head screwdriver and Allen key, along with twelve 8 mm screws.

SCP-9612 is the remains of a bonfire, located in a remote, forested area in [REDACTED], Ohio, USA. The structure is roughly 2.2 meters tall, with a 2x2-meter base. It was constructed in July of 1967.

Object seized from a clandestine art gallery in December 1997. SCP-9614 is the animated corpse of an eyeless pale woman. The item wears minimal antique clothing, and thin barbed wire extends up from its neck, hands, and feet until disappearing at an uncertain point above its head. Exposed bones, rotting tissue, and a few defensive marks on the forearms are visible. It remains floating two centimeters above the ground at all times.

SCP-9616 is a sentient and sapient swarm of between 3500 and 4000 anomalous Culex quinquefasciatus, commonly known as the southern house mosquito. SCP-9616 commonly forms a dense swarm in an appropriately humanoid shape. Individual SCP-9616 members, referred to as SCP-9616-A instances, live for approximately 2 weeks, performing a form of asexual reproduction at one week of age that produces a fully grown Culex quinquefasciatus. headaches
disequilibrium
confusion
memory loss
a feeling of loss
fear
dehydration

SCP-9621 is believed to be a single humanoid entity of unknown origin. The entity is estimated to be 1.9 m tall. Skin is white, with a texture similar to slightly creased paper with no signs of sexual organs or features aside from facial features. SCP-9621's eyes are two black, circular scribbles, no visible nose and a mouth that is a small, thin and black horizontal line. It has never been observed to alter its facial expression. On each hand, the entity has only four fingers, lacking thumbs. F

SCP-9622 is a recurrent dream experienced by residents of northern areas of the American state of Ohio. No pattern has been established between subjects with all residents of the affected area seeming equally likely to experience the anomaly. Memories of it are notably non-anomalous and will fade at a rate comparable to mundane dreams.

SCP-9625-1 is a small lemon tree that produces instances of SCP-9625. SCP-9625-1's appearance is standard for a lemon tree with the exception of a distinct glow while communicating. Interactions with SCP-9625-1 are possible only with SCP-

SCP-9627 describes a set of plastic tiles that manifest daily at 7pm in the break room of Site-627. This set will contain 9 to 24 plastic tiles with a varying number of sides and varying dimensions. These tiles will remain in the room for approximately 2 hours before they de-manifest at around 9pm.

SCP-9631-A resembles a vending machine, with the key difference being that the contents are not visible due to the glass being replaced by another wall. All attempts to destroy, open, or observe the interior of SCP-9631-A have failed.

SCP-9636 are a species of winged insectoid predators, on average measuring 50 cm with a diameter of 2 cm, and wingspan of 1.5 cm. Select instances have been measured upwards of 4 metres long. SCP-9636 possess translucent bodies resembling nematodes with multiple sets of evenly spaced wings across their lengths. SCP-9636 possess no facial attributes or orifices. SCP-9636 travel at speeds upwards of 286 km/h. SCP-9636 is imperceptible to most animals and has only been observed through recording eq

SCP-9640 is a form of ritual execution that was performed within the ancient Daevite Empire during times of conquest. The ritual, unlike many others of Daevite origin, does not rely on the use of glyphs, ritual objects, or innate thaumaturgical ability. Instead, the ritual's success is entirely dependent on non-anomalous factors. It is of note that no anomalous compulsion to perform SCP-9640 is known to exist.

Item is a potentially sentient strain of Baudoinia compniacensis that GOI-001 (The Chicago Spirit) cultivated for the purpose of deterring various anomalous entities in eastern Kentucky. Utilizing the remains of deceased individuals and natural limestone deposits, GOI-001 was able to distill a potable fluid that trivialized or negated anomalous presence. Due to the quantity of individuals required to create SCP-9643, and its potentially aggressive nature, mass production is presently unfeasible,

During these calls, they repeatedly requested the location of “secret shelters within the park,” claiming that an imminent disaster was approaching.

SCP-9648 are 16 mm long, octagonal, golden pills. Pressed into each is the symbol of a tree with a circle inside it on one side and the number "888" on the other. SCP-9648 are sold in quantities of 8 in blister packs packaged singularly into cardboard boxes. Branding on the boxes proports them to have been manufactured by the Oneiroi Collective under the name "Bhava." Chemical analysis has determined the items to be sugar pills.

"dado's life changing pills" is written in green marker on the bottle. No other text is present. SCP-9650 is the designation for a perpetually rising homemade hot air balloon and carriage. It does not appear to require sustained fuel for travel. Both SCP-9650 and its inhabitants are impervious to material and environmental conditions.

SCP-9653 refers to any rats birthed by RR-11, a Black Rat (Rattus rattus) modified in collaboration with the Department of Engineering and the Fire Suppression Department. All SCP-9653 instances are genetically identical clones of RR-1, measuring 14 centimeters in length with a 16-centimeter tail, and weighing 150 grams.
RR-1, and by extension all SCP-9653 instances, possess the ability to ontokinetically alter any detail about houses2 that SCP-9653 instances are in. They also possess geneticall
SCP-9655 is a species of worm within the phylum Nematomorpha1. SCP-9655 possesses the unique ability to parasitise any terrestrial animal, regardless of size or anatomy.

SCP-9658 is a recurring entity that manifests as an older Caucasian male and possesses behind the Veil knowledge classified under Level 5 clearance. The first registered sighting of SCP-9658 dates to 1936, when it visited multiple settlements in Eastern Poland, encouraging the residents to build the "Capital of the World" before the "apocalypse". The construction of a village called Wierszalin began in the same year; however, in 1939 local authorities arrested SCP-9658 for leading the unauthoriz

SCP-9660 was a targeted bioweapon deployed by the Pentagram, displaying numerous innovations in anomalous mathematics and biology that would have otherwise classified it as an eigenweapon if not for the highly localized nature of the tool, used to identify and assassinate key Foundation personnel responsible for counterintelligence and anti-espionage operations…

SCP-9663 is an anomalous Vachellia erioloba (camelthorn tree), located within South Africa's Kruger National Park. Unlike other instances of this species, the anomaly takes the form of a clonal colony,1 and forms a single multi-stem tree which covers an area of at least 6.2 hectares within the park, with the appearance of a dense wood of unique individual trees.
SCP-9663's roots are capable of breaching into other worlds through an unknown mechanism. As such, the full size of the anomaly is unkn

SCP-9664 is a 100 mL can of pressurized foam shaving cream. The can does not match the make of any known manufacturers; its label is branded with the phrase “lots-in-1 shave cream” in large bold text.1 Scattered across the label in smaller text are additional phrases such as “efficient bathroom substance,” “counter space saved,” and “travel easy.” On the back of the can, in much smaller print, is the phrase “product of FACTORY.”
The substance within the can is identical in composition to typical

SCP-9665 are anomalous humanoid entities manifesting near the skyscrapers of New York City. Although SCP-9665 seems to prefer older structures, it is presumed that the buildings chosen by the specimens are random. Instances of SCP-9665 are similar to middle-aged to elderly humans. No obvious patterns to their appearance have been observed so far, besides all instances encountered wearing a full gray-colored tweed suit. Multiple members of personnel have noted that SCP-9665 do not possess distinc

SCP-9666. Ground zero of WHITE ARROW is marked with an X.


SCP-9666 is an uninhabited island in the Baltic Sea, located approximately 30 kilometers away from the Danish island of Bornholm. It is the site of the final battle of the Seventh Occult War.
SCP-9666 was rendered uninhabitable by the deployment of the WHITE ARROW eigenweapon by the Allied Occult Initiative1 during Operation AEON DAWN. Living organisms exposed to SCP-9666 rapidly develop a flat affect and cease responding to external st
SCP-9667 is a 19 cm (7.5 in) long South American Hercules beetle (Dynastes hercules) that consistently identifies itself as a detective.

SCP-9669 denotes 6 identical pairs of cosmetic novelty glasses, designated SCP-9669-1 through -6. Instances of SCP-9669 have lenses with a variable but highly saturated tint.

SCP-9670 is the annual increase in anomalous activity within the bounds of the West Bank,1 coinciding with the olive harvesting season. SCP-9670 events usually occur in the vicinity of humans experiencing severe distress or in an otherwise highly emotional state. Objects created by SCP-9670 often display memetic or mnemonic characteristics.

Any speech or writing that describes SCP-9671 is cognitohazardous. Subjects affected by this hazard lose their willingness to interpret statements in any non-literal fashion. While they retain knowledge of literary/rhetorical devices such as metaphor, hyperbole, symbolism, and themes, they refuse to believe that these devices are ever deployed intentionally. Subjects are still capable of unintentionally using figurative language themselves.

SCP-9672-1 is the designation given to 12 pyramid-shaped objects approximately 3,500 km in width and height, which have been observed moving throughout the solar system. SCP-9672-2 resembles Balaenoptera musculus, commonly known as the blue whale, reaching a length of approximately 100 meters. At present, between 16-27 SCP-9672-2 are known to inhabit the solar system, predominantly remaining within SCP-9672-1.

SCP-9676 is a form of exotic life, currently the only known organism to be naturally capable of growing and reproducing in a vacuum.
SCP-9677 is a computer virus about 5 KB in size that primarily targets the model data of virtual YouTubers for infection.
SCP-9678 is classified as a stochastic field disruption that anomalously manifests in specific individuals (designated SCP-9678-1). The mechanism of selection remains unknown.

SCP-9679 is a 4.8 m1 tall long-case clock made of red wood and a gold-colored metal. At irregular intervals, SCP-9679 spontaneously moves itself across different locations in space and time. During such event, matter within 15 m2 are typically displaced alongside it.
Nine manifestations of SCP-9679 have been documented as of 2026 since its initial recovery in 1922. The interval of SCP-9679’s relocation events have ranged from several hours to multiple decades, with no identified correlation betw

SCP-9680 are specific packets of 30 different seed varieties from the Méndez Corporation. Species have been found to vary with no clear pattern or majority species, but primarily consist of food or textile crops (wheat, corn, cotton, sugarcane, etc.) SCP-9680 instances appear identical to nonanomalous equivalents sold by Méndez, but exhibit rapid growth patterns when planted. These extend to increased success not only in growth of planted seeds, but in seed production, pollen spread, and fruit p

SCP-9681 are the fossilized remains of an unknown clade of prehistoric life that do not conform to established biological, mathematical, and chronological principles. At present, over 300 instances of SCP-9681 have been exhumed globally.

SCP-9682 is a massive1 hostile entity which currently inhabits the Land of Harvest. It is quadrupedal, with each limb ending in several curved blades that can be extended and retracted at will. Its skin is protected by a dense, impermeable fuzz, upon which is patterned a multitude of dark spots resembling dead eyes.
SCP-9682 has not demonstrated the ability to feel fear or any fear-adjacent emotions, such as worry, caution, or suspicion. It is unknown if this is anomalous or simply a result of i

SCP-9686 is a standard 220V AC, 120 Watt light bulb that dims all light sources within a 20-meter effective range when activated. There are currently 27 22 SCP-9686 instances. The SCP has a ‘SERCO’ brand mark corresponding to its place of discovery. Its internal filament consists of an unidentified material distinct from tungsten, showing an irregular structure. Physical pressure exceeding █.█ Pa causes the filament to liquify immediately, making sample recovery impossible.

SCP-9688 is a metal toilet originally installed in the male public restroom at [REDACTED] Bus Station, England. When a human vomits into and then flushes SCP-9688, a stream of water laced with peppermint extract will be fired from inside its bowl, directly into the subject’s open mouth.
SCP-9690 is a humanoid male of undetermined origin. Prior to Foundation capture, he was employed as a performer in the entertainment industry.
SCP-9691 is an approximately 238 acre area in the Paimpont region of France, roughly located between SCPNAV coordinates 5426.1 and 49.852.7.

SCP-9692 is a behavioral phenomenon affecting resigned, defected, or discharged Foundation personnel who have been administered Class F amnestics and introduced to mundane society under Naturalization Protocol-I76. Persons affected by the phenomenon attempt to return to a Foundation Site despite total supplantation of memory relating to the Foundation and the location of its facilities.
